description: This header defines thread synchronization primitives such as mutex, scoped_lock, shared_variable, condition_variable, and related RAII classes within the ocudulog::detail namespace, providing abstractions over pthread mutexes and condition variables.

classes.name: mutex
classes.description: Abstraction of a pthread mutex with automatic initialization and destruction.

classes.name: scoped_lock
classes.description: RAII class for automatically locking and unlocking a mutex.

classes.name: shared_variable
classes.description: Template class for thread-safe access and modification of a variable.

classes.name: condition_variable
classes.description: Abstraction of a pthread condition variable with wait, signal, broadcast, and timeout capabilities.

classes.name: cond_var_scoped_lock
classes.description: RAII class for automatically locking and unlocking a condition variable.

methods.name: build_timeout
methods.description: Creates a timespec structure with an absolute timeout based on current time plus specified milliseconds.
